sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enlist T1 LEFT JOIN male T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T1.organ='fire_department'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.name) FROM person T1 LEFT JOIN male T2 ON T1.name=T2.name
SELECT name FROM (SELECT name FROM enrolled GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(school)=2) WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM enlist GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(organ)=2)
SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(month=0,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(month=9,1,0))) AS REAL)*100/SUM(IIF(month=0,1,0)) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT T1.name FROM male T1 JOIN unemployed T2 ON T1.name=T2.name JOIN disabled T3 ON T1.name=T3.name JOIN longest_absense_from_school T4 ON T1.name=T4.name WHERE T4.month=5
SELECT SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 LEFT JOIN male T2 ON T1.name=T2.name
